definition_zh: 交通；往来车辆；运输量；（非法）交易
definition_en: the vehicles moving along a road, or the movement of goods and people, and also illegal dealing in goods
core_image: 一条被车塞满的路，车灯一盏接一盏亮着
scene: 傍晚的高架桥上，车一辆贴着一辆，红色的尾灯一直排到看不见的地方。We left early to avoid the traffic on the ring road.
sceneCN: 这里 traffic 是「交通、往来车辆」（第 1 个义项：路上行驶的车辆及其流动）；句意为我们早早出发，以避开环路拥堵的车流。

pos.zh: 名词：交通；车流；运输；（非法）交易

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成（双写 k），义为「非法贩运者」
由动词加 -ing 构成（双写 k），义为「非法贩运」

senses.title: Vehicles moving on roads
senses.definition: the cars, buses, and lorries moving along a road at any one time
senses.definitionCN: 某一时刻在道路上行驶的汽车、公交与货车
senses.example: The traffic was so heavy we walked the last mile.
senses.exampleCN: 车流太堵，最后一英里我们是走过去的。
senses.why: The word comes from an Italian verb of trading, and traffic on a road is simply the commerce moving there.
senses.whyCN: 本词来自意大利语「做买卖」的动词，路上的车流就是在这条路上流动的商贸。

senses.title: The movement of goods and people
senses.definition: the movement of people or goods by road, rail, sea, or air
senses.definitionCN: 人或货物通过公路、铁路、海路或航空的流动
senses.example: The port handles freight traffic from three continents.
senses.exampleCN: 这个港口处理来自三大洲的货运。
senses.why: Once the word means movement, it can measure that movement in tonnes and passengers rather than count cars.
senses.whyCN: 一旦本词表示流动，就可以用吨位和客流来度量这种流动，而不只是数车。

senses.title: The number of visitors to a place
senses.definition: the amount of people or data passing through a place or system in a period
senses.definitionCN: 一段时间内通过某地或某系统的客流或数据量
senses.example: The website had record traffic after the article appeared.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇文章出现后，网站访问量创了纪录。
senses.why: A modern network also has traffic, since messages move through it as goods move along roads.
senses.whyCN: 现代网络也有 traffic，因为消息在网络中的流动正如货物在路上的流动。

senses.title: Illegal dealing in goods
senses.definition: the buying and selling of something illegal, such as drugs or stolen goods
senses.definitionCN: 买卖毒品、赃物等违法物品
senses.example: The police broke up a traffic in stolen bicycles.
senses.exampleCN: 警方打掉了一桩被盗自行车的交易。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: trade itself, which turns dark when the goods are forbidden.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的含义：贸易本身，当货物被禁时就变成了黑色交易。

senses.title: To deal illegally
senses.definition: to buy and sell something illegal, used mostly in the form trafficking
senses.definitionCN: 买卖违法物品，多见于 trafficking 这一形式
senses.example: They were charged with trafficking in protected birds.
senses.exampleCN: 他们被控非法买卖受保护的鸟类。
senses.why: The verb keeps only the unlawful branch of the old trade meaning, so it almost always names a crime.
senses.whyCN: 动词只保留了旧「贸易」义中不合法的那一支，因此几乎总指犯罪。

intro.en: Traffic comes from Italian traffico, trade, probably from trafficare, to trade, with a possible ultimate link to a word for grinding or moving about.
intro.cn: traffic 来自意大利语 traffico（贸易），大概出自 trafficare（做买卖），其更远来源可能与表示「碾磨、往来」的词有关。

items.en: The deeper source is disputed; some trace it to a Vulgar Latin verb of moving goods about, others to an Arabic root.
items.cn: 更深来源有争议，有人追溯到通俗拉丁语表示搬运货物的动词，也有人主张来自阿拉伯语词根。

items.en: Italian traffico means commerce or trade, often with a hint of dealings that are not quite clean.
items.cn: 意大利语 traffico 意为商业、贸易，常带着「不太干净的买卖」的暗示。

items.en: French trafic carries the word into wider use in the sixteenth century, still meaning trade.
items.cn: 十六世纪法语 trafic 把这个词带进更广的使用，仍指贸易。

items.en: English adopts traffic for trade, and the phrase traffic in goods becomes common.
items.cn: 英语借入 traffic 表示贸易，traffic in goods 一类说法变得常见。

items.en: In the nineteenth century, with railways and busy streets, the word shifts to the movement of vehicles.
items.cn: 十九世纪随着铁路与繁忙街道的出现，这个词转向指车辆的流动。

items.en: The unlawful sense survives mainly in phrases such as drug trafficking and the verb traffick.
items.cn: 不合法之义主要保存在 drug trafficking 一类说法与动词 traffick 中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the traffic family, and the near-meaning group gathers words for vehicles, congestion, and trade.
note.cn: 形近组收集 traffic 词族，近义组收集表示车辆、拥堵与贸易的词。

illegal trading

entries.definitionCN: 悲惨的，拼写相近而来源不同

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the Italian trade origin, from the uncountable noun, and from the two branches of road flow and illegal dealing.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从意大利语「贸易」来源、不可数名词属性以及「车流」与「非法交易」两条分支入手。

normal.en: Traffic began as trade, so the cars on a road are goods of a sort, moving.
normal.cn: traffic 原是贸易，所以路上的车某种意义上也是流动的货物。

normal.en: As a noun traffic has no plural: say heavy traffic, not many traffics.
normal.cn: 作名词时 traffic 没有复数：说 heavy traffic，而不说 many traffics。

normal.en: The verb doubles the k: trafficked, trafficking, trafficker.
normal.cn: 动词要双写 k：trafficked、trafficking、trafficker。

normal.en: Traffic lights, traffic jam, traffic accident: the word stands in front to say where the flow is short.
normal.cn: traffic lights、traffic jam、traffic accident，本词放前面说明流动受阻之处。

normal.en: Traffic in drugs is the old trade sense surviving in criminal form.
normal.cn: traffic in drugs 是古老贸易义以犯罪形式留存下来的样子。

abstract.en: Picture a river of red tail lights that moves only a few metres at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象一条红色尾灯的河，每次只前挪几米。

abstract.en: Think of ants on a sugar trail, and then make the ants into lorries.
abstract.cn: 想糖迹上的一队蚂蚁，再把蚂蚁换成货车。

abstract.en: Traffic is other people's decisions taking up room on your road.
abstract.cn: 交通就是别人的决定占了你路上的位置。

examples.en: There was a lot of traffic on the coast road this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上沿海路上车很多。

examples.en: The new traffic lights made the junction much safer.
examples.cn: 新的红绿灯让这个路口安全多了。

examples.en: He was arrested for trafficking in stolen goods.
examples.cn: 他因买卖赃物被捕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳非克」——车子一辆戳着一辆，挤得谁也过不去，就是交通堵。

root: 意大利语 traffico（贸易）→ 法语 trafic → 英语 traffic（贸易 → 车流）。更远来源有争议，可能与表示搬运、往来的词有关。词族有 trafficker、trafficking。

sensesIntro.en: The entry begins with the oldest sense of trade, then turns into the movement of goods, then into the vehicles themselves, then into the flow through networks, and ends with the criminal branch of dealing in forbidden goods.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从「贸易」这一最古老含义出发，转为货物流动，再转为车辆本身，再转为网络中的流量，最后落在买卖违禁品的犯罪分支上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a road thick with moving vehicles.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条挤满移动车辆的路。

branches.en: The cars and buses on the road.
branches.cn: 路上的汽车与公交。

branches.en: The freight and passengers moved.
branches.cn: 被运送的货物与旅客。

branches.en: The volume passing through a place.
branches.cn: 通过某地的人流量。

branches.en: Trade in forbidden goods, noun and verb.
branches.cn: 违禁品买卖，名词与动词。

branches.en: The crowded road that started the circle.
branches.cn: 开启这一循环的拥堵路面。

intro.en: The word is a French borrowing from Italian with no productive suffix, and its small family uses -er and -ing with a doubled k.
intro.cn: 本词是经法语借入的意大利语词，没有能产后缀，其小词族用 -er 与 -ing，并双写 k。

latinIntro.en: There is no certain Latin source, so no Latin entries are listed for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有确定的拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条。

items.example: The trade sense survives in traffic in drugs.
items.exampleCN: 贸易义保留在 traffic in drugs 中。

items.example: A trafficker deals in illegal goods.
Trafficking can be stopped at the port.
items.exampleCN: 走私可以在港口被拦住。

items.example: A traffic jam holds the cars still.
A traffic accident closed the road.
Heavy traffic slows the whole city.

definition_zh: 火车；列车；一系列；随从；（作动词）训练；培养
definition_en: a line of connected railway carriages pulled by an engine, or a connected series of things; and to teach or practise a skill
core_image: 一节车厢连着一节车厢，由前面的机车拉着往前走
scene: 站台上的人把箱子往前挪了挪，远处一列长长的车正慢慢地收住速度。The train pulled into the station exactly on time.
sceneCN: 这里 train 是「火车、列车」（第 1 个义项：由机车牵引的一列车厢）；句意为那列火车准点驶进了车站。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「训练；培训」
由动词加 -ee 构成，义为「受训者」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「教练；训练者」

senses.title: Railway carriages pulled by an engine
senses.definition: a line of railway carriages or wagons joined together and pulled by an engine
senses.definitionCN: 由机车牵引、首尾相连的一列铁路车厢
senses.example: The night train to the coast leaves at ten.
senses.exampleCN: 去海边的夜车十点发车。
senses.why: The French source means something dragged along, and a train is literally a line of things dragged behind an engine.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源意为被拖着的东西，而火车字面上就是一串被拖在机车后面的东西。

senses.title: A connected series of things
senses.definition: a sequence of events, ideas, or objects that follow one after another
senses.definitionCN: 一个接一个相继发生的事件、想法或物件
senses.example: The news broke his train of thought completely.
senses.exampleCN: 这个消息把他的思路彻底打断了。
senses.why: A line of carriages is the model for any line of things, so the word becomes a general word for series.
senses.whyCN: 一串车厢是任何一串事物的模型，于是这个词成为泛指「系列」的词。

senses.title: The followers of an important person
senses.definition: a group of servants or attendants travelling behind a person of rank
senses.definitionCN: 跟在显贵身后同行的一群仆从或随员
senses.example: The queen arrived with a train of forty attendants.
senses.exampleCN: 女王带着四十名随从到来。
senses.why: People following in order are dragged behind in a line, just as carriages are, so the word covers a retinue.
senses.whyCN: 按次序跟着的人正如车厢一样被拖成一列，所以这个词也指随行队伍。

senses.title: The long back part of a dress
senses.definition: the long part of a formal dress or robe that drags behind the wearer
senses.definitionCN: 礼服或长袍身后拖地的长摆
senses.example: Two children carried the bride's train up the steps.
senses.exampleCN: 两个孩子把新娘的裙裾提上台阶。
senses.why: The dragging part of a garment is the most physical remnant of the original dragging sense.
senses.whyCN: 衣袍被拖着的部分，是原始「拖」义最具体的遗留。

senses.title: To teach and practise a skill
senses.definition: to teach a person or animal a skill through repeated practice
senses.definitionCN: 通过反复练习教人或动物掌握某项技能
senses.example: She trains new staff for six weeks before they start.
senses.exampleCN: 新员工上岗前她培训他们六周。
senses.why: From dragging things in a line comes the idea of leading someone along a course, and so of forming them by practice.
senses.whyCN: 从把事物拖成一列，发展出把人带着走完一段课程的想法，于是形成「以练习培养」之义。

senses.title: To prepare for a contest
senses.definition: to exercise and practise regularly in order to be ready for a sport or event
senses.definitionCN: 为备战某项运动或赛事而定期锻炼练习
senses.example: He trains in the pool every morning at six.
senses.exampleCN: 他每天早上六点在泳池里训练。
senses.why: The person being formed by practice can also form himself, so the verb becomes intransitive.
senses.whyCN: 被练习塑造的人也可以自己塑造自己，于是这个动词有了不及物用法。

intro.en: Train comes from Old French trahiner, to drag, from Latin trahere, to pull; the sense of a railway train dates from the 1820s.
intro.cn: train 来自古法语 trahiner（拖），源自拉丁语 trahere（拉）；表示火车的意思始于十九世纪二十年代。

items.en: Trahere means to pull or drag, and its stem underlies a large family in English.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、拖，其词干在英语中撑起一个大家族。

items.en: Trahiner means to drag along, and the noun train means something dragged or a line of things.
items.cn: 古法语 trahiner 意为沿地拖，名词 train 意为被拖之物或一列东西。

items.en: English borrows train for a trailing part, a retinue, and a sequence of events.
items.cn: 英语借入 train，指拖尾部分、随从以及一连串事件。

items.en: With the railways of the 1820s the word settles on the line of carriages, which becomes its dominant sense.
items.cn: 十九世纪二十年代铁路出现后，这个词固定在「一列车厢」上，成为其主要含义。

items.en: The verb to train, meaning to bring a person or animal along by practice, is older and grows in use with armies and schools.
items.cn: 动词 train 意为通过练习把人或动物培养出来，这一用法更早，并随军队与学校的发展而增多。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the -ing, -ee, and -er forms, while the near-meaning group gathers rail terms and teaching words.
note.cn: 形近组收集 -ing、-ee、-er 等形式，近义组收集铁路术语与教学类词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the dragging origin, from the compound phrases, and from the -ing, -ee, -er family.
normalIntro.cn: 「拖」的原义、常用搭配以及 -ing、-ee、-er 词族入手。

normal.en: A train is a line of things dragged along, so the carriages and the dress train are the same picture.
normal.cn: 火车是一串被拖着走的东西，所以车厢与裙裾是同一幅画面。

normal.en: Train of thought: thoughts follow one after another like carriages.
normal.cn: train of thought，想法像车厢一样一节接一节。

normal.en: Training is the activity, a trainee is the person learning, a trainer is the person teaching.
normal.cn: training 是活动，trainee 是学习的人，trainer 是教的人。

normal.en: By train, catch a train, miss a train: the transport sense takes articles freely.
normal.cn: by train、catch a train、miss a train，交通义可以自由加冠词。

normal.en: To train is to walk someone along a course until the skill sticks.
normal.cn: to train 就是带着某人走完一段课程，直到技能定型。

abstract.en: Picture a long dark line of carriages curving into the station.
abstract.cn: 想象一列深色车厢弯进车站的长长的样子。

abstract.en: Think of a queen's long robe held up by two children on stone steps.
abstract.cn: 想女王的长袍在两个孩子的搀扶下走过石阶。

abstract.en: A train is a plan made of steel, always arriving before its own end.
abstract.cn: 火车是用钢做成的计划，总在自己终点之前先到站。

examples.en: The letter broke my train of thought.

examples.en: The dogs are trained to search for people in snow.
examples.cn: 这些狗受过在雪中寻人的训练。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扯你」——前面机车一扯，后面的车厢全跟着走，就是一列车。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉、拖）→ 古法语 trahiner（沿地拖）→ 中古英语 train（拖尾、随从、序列）→ 近代英语 train（列车；训练）。词族有 training、trainee、trainer。

sensesIntro.en: Everything starts from dragging: the dragged line gives carriages and dress trains, the line of followers gives a retinue, the line of events gives a series, and the leading of people along a course gives the verb to train.
sensesIntro.cn: 一切都从拖拽开始：被拖的线给出车厢与裙裾，跟成一列的人给出随从，排成一串的事件给出系列，而带着人走完课程则给出动词「训练」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line of connected things pulled along in order.
core.cn: 核心意象：一串相连之物依序被拉着前行。

branches.en: The railway train.
branches.cn: 铁路列车。

branches.en: Any series in a line.
branches.cn: 任何成串的序列。

branches.en: Followers in line and cloth dragged behind.
branches.cn: 排成一列的随从与身后的拖布。

branches.en: Leading someone along a course of practice.
branches.cn: 带着人走完练习的课程。

branches.en: The learner's own repeated practice.
branches.cn: 学习者自身的反复练习。

intro.en: The word is a French borrowing from the Latin pulling verb, and its family uses -ing, -ee, and -er.
intro.cn: 本词是经法语借入的拉丁「拉」动词词族，其词族使用 -ing、-ee、-er。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pulling verb and its participle are the base of this family and of many prefixed relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁「拉」动词及其分词是这个词族以及众多前缀词的根基。

definition_zh: 翻译；译成；转化；解释；被译成
definition_en: to express words in another language, or to change something into a different form or result
core_image: 一句话从一个人嘴里出来，落到另一个人嘴里时换了一副字
scene: 餐桌上，一位老奶奶只会方言，孙女把她的吩咐一句句换成普通话讲给客人听。She translated her grandmother’s story for the guests.
sceneCN: 这里 translate 是「把话译成另一种语言」（第 1 个义项：口头或书面翻译）；句意为她把奶奶讲的故事译给客人听。话从一张嘴搬到另一张嘴的画面正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ion 构成名词，义为「翻译；译文」
动词加 -or 构成，义为「译者；翻译员」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可译的」

senses.title: To express in another language
senses.definition: to say or write words again in a different language
senses.definitionCN: 用另一种语言把话语或文字重新表达
senses.example: She translates poetry from Japanese into English.
senses.exampleCN: 她把日本诗歌译成英文。
senses.why: The Latin latus means carried, so to translate is to carry a meaning across into another tongue.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 latus 意为「被搬运」，所以 translate 就是把意义搬到另一种语言里。

senses.title: To turn into another form or result
senses.definition: to change something into a different form or practical result
senses.definitionCN: 把某物变成另一种形式或实际结果
senses.example: Good plans rarely translate into good results easily.
senses.exampleCN: 好计划很少能轻易变成好结果。
senses.why: Once meaning can be carried across, any conversion from one state to another fits the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 既然意义能被搬过去，那么任何从一种状态到另一种的转换都能用这个动词。

senses.title: To explain or understand in one’s own terms
senses.definition: to explain or understand something in a way one can grasp
senses.definitionCN: 用自己能把握的方式解释或理解某物
senses.example: He translated her silence as agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 他把她的沉默理解为同意。
senses.why: Readers carry a text into their own frame, and that carrying is also a translation.
senses.whyCN: 读者把文本搬进自己的框架，这一次搬运同样是翻译。

senses.title: To be capable of being translated
senses.definition: to be able to be put into another language with its meaning kept
senses.definitionCN: 能被译成另一种语言而意义不失
senses.example: This joke does not translate well.
senses.exampleCN: 这个笑话一译就走味。
senses.why: When the load cannot be carried without damage, we say the thing does not translate.
senses.whyCN: 当那担货搬过去必然受损时，我们就说这个东西译不好。

senses.title: To move a bishop to another see
senses.definition: to move a bishop from one diocese to another
senses.definitionCN: 把主教从一个教区调到另一个
senses.example: He was translated to a northern diocese.
senses.exampleCN: 他被调任到北方一个教区。
senses.why: This is the oldest English sense: a holy man is carried to a new seat.
senses.whyCN: 这是英语里最古老的义项：把神职人员搬到新的座位。

intro.en: The verb comes from Latin translatus, the past participle of transferre, to carry across.
intro.cn: 这个动词来自拉丁语 translatus，是 transferre（搬运过去）的过去分词。

items.en: Ferre means to carry, and its participle latus means carried, born, or brought.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 意为搬运，其分词 latus 意为被搬、被承载。

items.en: Translatus is a carrying across, used of moving goods, of people, and later of meaning.
items.cn: translatus 是一次搬运过去，先用于货物与人，后用于意义。

items.en: Old French translater gives English the verb with the sense of turning text into another tongue.
items.cn: 古法语 translater 把这个动词传入英语，含「把文本换成另一种语言」之义。

items.en: English uses it from the fourteenth century for rendering texts, and later for other conversions.
items.cn: 英语从十四世纪用它指译文本，后来又扩及其他转换。

items.en: Biology and business extend it to protein synthesis and to results.
items.cn: 生物学与商业又把它扩展到蛋白质合成与成效。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -lat- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other verbs about rendering and explaining.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -lat- 词干，近义组汇集表示转换与解释的其他动词。

entries.definition: the act or result of rendering into another language
a person who translates
to move something to another place
to connect one thing with another
to express something in another form
to explain the meaning of something
to restate in other words
to change into another form

normalIntro.en: The -lat- inside the word is the Latin participle carried, and it ties the whole family together.
normalIntro.cn: 词中的 -lat- 就是拉丁语分词「被搬运」，把整个词族连在一起。

normal.en: Trans- is across and latus is carried, so translate is to carry meaning across.
normal.cn: trans- 是跨过，latus 是被搬运，所以 translate 就是把意义搬过去。

normal.en: Translation is the act or the text, translator is the person.
normal.cn: translation 是行为或文本，translator 是人。

normal.en: Transfer and relate are cousins, built on the same carried root.
normal.cn: transfer 与 relate 是表亲，建在同一个「搬运」词根上。

normal.en: Ideas can be translated into action, which is the figurative use.
normal.cn: 想法可以 translate into action，这是比喻用法。

normal.en: A joke that does not translate loses its point on the way across.
normal.cn: 译不通的笑话在搬运途中丢了意思。

abstract.en: Picture one sentence stepping off a boat on the other shore.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话在彼岸下船。

abstract.en: Hear it land in another alphabet, the meaning still whole.
abstract.cn: 听它落在另一套字母里，意思仍然完整。

abstract.en: Then picture the same sentence as a plan, landing as a deed.
abstract.cn: 再把这同一句话想成计划，落地时成了行动。

examples.en: He translates French novels for a living.
examples.cn: 他靠翻译法国小说为生。

examples.en: Their enthusiasm did not translate into votes.
examples.cn: 他们的热情并没有变成选票。

examples.en: I translated his silence as a refusal.
examples.cn: 我把他的沉默理解为拒绝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯雷特」——把话穿过一条街，送到雷特先生的耳朵里。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ latus（ferre「搬运」的过去分词），动词 transferre 经古法语 translater 进入英语；同族有 transfer、relate

sensesIntro.en: The senses all describe carrying something across a gap: a language, a state, or a silence.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项都描述把某物跨过一道距离搬过去：跨语言、跨状态，或跨过一段沉默。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sentence leaving one mouth and landing in another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句话从一张嘴出来，落进另一张嘴。

branches.en: The language pair: rendering a text, and failing to render it well.
branches.cn: 语言一对：把文本译出，或译不好。

branches.en: The conversion sense, where a plan becomes a result.
branches.cn: 转化义：计划变成结果。

branches.en: The reading sense, where a silence is carried into meaning.
branches.cn: 阅读义：沉默被搬成意义。

branches.en: The church sense, where a bishop is carried to a new seat.
branches.cn: 教会义：主教被搬到新的座位。

branches.en: The plain translating sense, where words are the load.
branches.cn: 朴素翻译义：那担货是词语。

intro.en: The verb is a Latin prefix of crossing plus the participle of the verb to carry.
intro.cn: 这个动词是表示跨越的拉丁前缀加上「搬运」动词的分词。

latinIntro.en: Ferre and its participle latus lie behind a very large English family.
latinIntro.cn: ferre 及其分词 latus 支撑着一个非常庞大的英语词族。

items.example: Transit goods pass through a country.
items.exampleCN: transit 的货物过境一个国家。
latus 支撑着 translate 与 relate。

items.example: Transfer the file to a disk.
Relate the result to the cause.
items.exampleCN: 把结果与原因联系起来。

items.example: The footnote refers to page ten.

definition_zh: 垃圾；废物；蹩脚货；丢弃；捣毁
definition_en: things thrown away because they are no longer wanted, or to throw such things away or destroy them
core_image: 楼道口一只鼓鼓的垃圾袋，袋口露出几根果皮
scene: 清晨，环卫车沿街收走门口一袋袋垃圾，纸箱被压扁堆在路边。Please take the trash out before you leave.
sceneCN: 这里 trash 是「垃圾」（第 1 个义项：扔掉的废弃物）；句意为走之前把垃圾拿出去。门口那一袋袋东西正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 名词加 -y 构成形容词，义为「劣质的；低俗的」
复合名词，义为「垃圾桶」（美式）
现在分词名词化，义为「捣毁；痛批」

senses.title: Things thrown away
senses.definition: things that are no longer wanted and are thrown out
senses.definitionCN: 不再需要、被扔掉的东西
senses.example: The kitchen trash smells in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天厨房的垃圾会有味道。
senses.why: The word began as a name for broken twigs and dry leaves, the stuff that falls and is swept up.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早指折断的细枝与枯叶，即落下后被扫走的东西。

senses.title: Something of poor quality
senses.definition: things or work that are worthless or of very low quality
senses.definitionCN: 没有价值或质量极差的东西或作品
senses.example: The film is pure trash.
senses.exampleCN: 这部片子完全是垃圾。
senses.why: If what is thrown away is worthless, anything worthless can be called trash.
senses.whyCN: 既然扔掉的东西没有价值，任何没价值的东西都能叫 trash。

senses.title: To throw something away
senses.definition: to get rid of something as useless
senses.definitionCN: 把某物当作无用之物处理掉
senses.example: Trash the old receipts once they are checked.
senses.exampleCN: 旧收据核对完就扔掉。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb when the action of discarding is what needs naming.
senses.whyCN: 当需要给「抛弃」这个动作起名时，名词就变成了动词。

senses.title: To damage or destroy badly
senses.definition: to wreck a place or attack something severely
senses.definitionCN: 把地方砸坏，或把某物批得体无完肤
senses.example: Fans trashed the hall after the show.
senses.exampleCN: 演出结束后粉丝把礼堂砸了。
senses.why: Treating something as trash is the same as destroying it, so the verb widens to wrecking.
senses.whyCN: 把东西当垃圾处理就等于毁掉它，于是动词扩展到「砸烂」。

senses.title: To criticise harshly
senses.definition: to write or speak about something very unfavourably
senses.definitionCN: 极不客气地评论某物
senses.example: Every critic trashed the new play.
senses.exampleCN: 每个评论家都痛批这出新戏。
senses.why: When a review throws a work away in words, the verb for discarding fits the judging.
senses.whyCN: 当评论用文字把作品扔掉时，表示丢弃的这个动词正好贴合那种评判。

intro.en: The word is of uncertain origin, first naming broken twigs and dry leaves, then any rubbish.
intro.cn: 这个词来源不确定，最早指折断的细枝与枯叶，后来泛指一切废物。

items.en: The word appears in the sixteenth century as a name for withered leaves and twigs.
items.cn: 这个词在十六世纪出现，指枯叶与细枝。

items.en: American usage of the nineteenth century widens trash to household rubbish.
items.cn: 十九世纪美国用法把 trash 扩大到家庭垃圾。

items.en: Rubbish, garbage, and trash divide the work differently in British and American English.
items.cn: rubbish、garbage 与 trash 在英式与美式英语里分工不同。

items.en: The verb sense of destroying a place spreads through journalism in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 动词「砸坏一个地方」的义项在二十世纪经新闻传播开来。

items.en: The word now also covers poor quality in films, music, and writing.
items.cn: 如今这个词也涵盖电影、音乐与写作的低劣之作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words that look close, while the near-meaning group names other kinds of waste.
note.cn: 形近组汇集外形接近的短词，近义组列出其他废弃物的说法。

entries.definition: a small sign that something was there
a sudden bright light
a violent collision
of very poor quality
waste material, in British English
household waste, especially food
material left over and not used

normalIntro.en: A short, blunt word, suited to the thing it names.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词又短又硬，正配它所指的东西。

normal.en: Three letters and one sh sound, harsh like a bin lid.
normal.cn: 三个字母，一声 sh，脆得像垃圾桶盖合上。

normal.en: Trash can is American; British speakers more often say rubbish bin.
normal.cn: trash can 是美式，英式多说 rubbish bin。

normal.en: The verb trashes a room, and the noun names what is left.
normal.cn: 动词把房间砸烂，名词指的是留下的一地。

normal.en: Trashy adds -y to make an adjective of poor quality.
normal.cn: trashy 加 -y 成为「劣质」的形容词。

normal.en: A short, blunt word, suited to a quick shove.
normal.cn: 短而硬的词，正配随手一推的动作。

abstract.en: Picture a bin bag split at the corner of a stairwell.
abstract.cn: 想象楼道口一只裂了口的垃圾袋。

abstract.en: Smell it on a hot morning and the word sticks.
abstract.cn: 在热天早晨闻一闻，这个词就记住了。

abstract.en: Then hear a critic say the same word about a play.
abstract.cn: 再听评论家用同一个词评一出戏。

examples.en: Put the trash out on Tuesday night.
examples.cn: 周二晚上把垃圾拿出去。

examples.en: Do not trash the hotel room.
examples.cn: 不要把酒店房间弄得一团糟。

examples.en: Some of that music is real trash.
examples.cn: 那些音乐里有不少真是糟粕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抓什」——抓到什么都往垃圾堆里扔。

root: 来源不确定，十六世纪指枯枝落叶，后泛指垃圾；同族有 trashy、trashcan

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with what is swept up and ends with what is thrown away in words.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从被扫起来的东西开始，一路走到被文字判掉的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bulging bin bag at the foot of the stairs.
core.cn: 核心意象：楼梯脚下一只鼓鼓的垃圾袋。

branches.en: The plain sense of household waste.
branches.cn: 最朴素义：家庭垃圾。

branches.en: The quality sense, where worthless things are meant.
branches.cn: 品质义：指的是没价值的东西。

branches.en: The verb senses: throw away, then wreck.
branches.cn: 动词义：先扔掉，再砸烂。

branches.en: The reviewing sense, where a work is thrown away in print.
branches.cn: 评论义：作品在纸上被扔掉。

branches.en: The bin sense, the everyday picture of the word.
branches.cn: 垃圾桶义：这个词最日常的画面。

intro.en: The word has no useful Latin pieces, but its English family is easy to see.
intro.cn: 这个词没有可用的拉丁部件，但它的英语词族很容易看出。

latinIntro.en: The stem trash- appears in trashy, trashcan, and trashing.
latinIntro.cn: 词干 trash- 出现在 trashy、trashcan 与 trashing 里。

items.example: The stem is the whole noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干就是名词的全部。
trash 加 can 成为 trashcan。

items.example: The trashing of the site caused anger.
items.exampleCN: 对场地的捣毁引发了愤怒。

items.example: Garbage goes in the other bin.

latinEntries.meaning: withered leaves and twigs, then rubbish

definition_zh: 旅行；出行；游历；传播；移动
definition_en: to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance
core_image: 背起行囊离开熟悉的地方，一路向前走到陌生的城市
scene: 暑假一开始，很多人收拾行李离开家乡。They plan to travel across Europe by train this summer.
sceneCN: 这里 travel 是「旅行、出游」（第 1 个义项：从一个地方前往另一个地方）；句意是他们计划今年夏天乘火车横穿欧洲旅行。

derivatives.zh: travel 加表示人的后缀 -er，义为「旅行者；旅客」
travel 的现在分词作形容词，义为「旅行的；巡回的」

senses.title: To go from one place to another
senses.definition: to make a journey from one place to another, especially a long one
senses.definitionCN: 从一个地方前往另一个地方，尤指长途的行程
senses.example: They travelled to Japan for their holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们去日本度假旅行。
senses.why: The core image is leaving familiar ground and covering distance, so the first sense is simply making a journey.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是离开熟悉的地方、跨过距离，所以第一个义项就是「进行一次旅程」本身。

senses.title: To move or be carried from place to place
senses.definition: to move or be moved from one place to another as part of a journey or a route
senses.definitionCN: 沿路线移动或被运送，从一处到另一处
senses.example: The mail travels by plane and train.
senses.exampleCN: 邮件经飞机和火车运送。
senses.why: If people can travel, things and vehicles can follow routes too, so the image widens to any movement along a path.
senses.whyCN: 人能出行，物品和交通工具也能沿路线移动，画面就从「人旅行」扩展到「任何沿路径的运动」。

senses.title: To spread from one place to another
senses.definition: to spread or pass from one person, place, or thing to others, such as news, disease, or light
senses.definitionCN: 消息、疾病、光等从一处传到另一处；传播、蔓延
senses.example: The virus travelled quickly through the city.
senses.exampleCN: 病毒在城市里迅速传播。
senses.why: Movement from place to place applies to intangible things too, so the image of covering distance grows into spreading.
senses.whyCN: 「从一处到另一处」同样适用于无形之物，跨越距离的画面自然延伸为「传播、蔓延」。

senses.title: To move fast or with effort
senses.definition: to move with speed, or to move a machine part quickly along a track
senses.definitionCN: 以很快的速度移动；机器部件沿轨道快速滑动
senses.example: The bullet travelled through the air.
senses.exampleCN: 子弹在空中飞驰而过。
senses.why: Covering distance can be fast and forceful, so the same movement sense stretches to high speed and machine parts.
senses.whyCN: 跨越距离可以是快速而有力的，同一「移动」义便延伸到高速运动与机械部件的滑动。

senses.title: The activity of taking journeys
senses.definition: the activity of making journeys, especially as a general habit or industry
senses.definitionCN: 旅行这一活动本身，尤指作为习惯或行业
senses.example: Travel broadens the mind.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行开阔眼界。
senses.why: When the action of moving from place to place is named as a thing, it becomes the noun sense of travel.
senses.whyCN: 当「从一地到另一地」这个动作被当作一件事来称呼时，就形成了 travel 的名词义项。

senses.title: A journey or series of journeys
senses.definition: a journey, or the journeys that someone makes, often used in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 一次旅程，或某人经历的多段旅程，常用复数
senses.example: She wrote a book about her travels in Asia.
senses.exampleCN: 她写了一本关于亚洲游历的书。
senses.why: The noun can also count the journeys themselves, so a whole trip or lifetime of trips is called travels.
senses.whyCN: 名词还可以把旅程本身作为对象来数说，于是整段行程或一生的游历被称为 travels。

senses.title: To move a machine part along a path
senses.definition: to move a part of a machine, or the distance that such a part can move
senses.definitionCN: 机器部件沿路径移动；也指部件可移动的距离即行程
senses.example: The piston travels up and down the cylinder.
senses.exampleCN: 活塞在气缸内上下移动。
senses.why: Machines copy the image of moving along a path, and the measured distance of that path becomes a technical sense.
senses.whyCN: 机械复制了「沿路径移动」的画面，这条路径的长度又被量化，形成技术上的「行程」义。

senses.title: To pass over a distance with speed
senses.definition: to pass over a particular distance, said of balls, light, sound, and similar things
senses.definitionCN: 球、光、声音等在空间中掠过某段距离
senses.example: The ball travelled twenty metres before it landed.
senses.exampleCN: 球飞出二十米才落地。
senses.why: Light, sound, and balls also cross distances, so the movement image covers any object passing over space.
senses.whyCN: 光、声音、球体同样会跨越距离，「跨越空间」的画面便涵盖一切掠过距离的物体。

intro.en: Travel goes back to the Latin word for a work tool, and its painful origin still hides inside the friendly modern word.
intro.cn: travel 的源头是拉丁语中表示「劳作工具」的词，它 painful 的本义仍藏在今天轻松的旅行一词背后。

items.en: Latin trepalium is generally thought to have meant an instrument of torture, though the exact form of the device is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为拉丁语 trepalium 指一种刑具，但该器械的具体形制已不可考。

items.en: Old French travailler came to mean to toil, to labor painfully, and travailler appeared by the twelfth century.
items.cn: 古法语 travailler 至十二世纪已表示「辛苦劳作、艰难做工」。

items.en: Middle English adopted travailen in the sense of to toil and to struggle, and it also meant to make a journey, because journeys were hardship.
items.cn: 中古英语借用 travailen，既表示「劳苦、挣扎」，也表示「长途跋涉」，因为那时的旅程本身就是苦役。

items.en: In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries the word split into travail, which kept the meaning of painful labor, and travel, which kept the meaning of journeying.
items.cn: 十五至十六世纪，该词分化为 travail（保留「辛劳」义）和 travel（保留「旅行」义）。

items.en: Modern English travel keeps the journey sense for people, goods, light, and news, while travail survives as a formal word for painful effort.
items.cn: 现代英语中 travel 用于人、货物、光线、消息的移动，travail 则作为正式用词保留「艰辛劳作」之义。

note.en: Travel has a famous look-alike from the same ancestor, and several journey words sit close to it in meaning.
note.cn: travel 有一个同源的著名形近词，另有一些表示「旅程」的词在意义上与之相近。

entries.definition: painful or laborious effort; the older sister of travel
entries.definitionCN: 艰辛的劳作或痛苦的努力；与 travel 同源，是保留古义的「兄弟词」

entries.definition: a person who is travelling; British double-l spelling
entries.definitionCN: 旅行者；英式拼写为双写 l，美式写作 traveler

entries.definition: to cross or pass over an area; only spelling resembles travel, root is different
entries.definitionCN: 横越、穿过某区域；只是拼写与 travel 相近，词源不同（源自拉丁 trans-versus）

entries.definition: an act of traveling from one place to another, especially a long one
entries.definitionCN: 从一地到另一地的行程，尤指长途旅行；作名词为主

entries.definition: a long journey by sea or in space
entries.definitionCN: 经海路或太空的长途航行；travel 不限交通方式

entries.definition: a journey for pleasure during which you visit several places
entries.definitionCN: 以观光为目的、辗转多地的旅行；travel 泛指出行行为

normalIntro.en: Use the shared ancestor travail to link travel with its family and set phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 利用共同祖先 travail 把 travel 与词族和固定搭配串起来记。

normal.en: travel comes from the same French root as travail: long journeys once meant hard labor.
normal.cn: travel 与 travail 同源：旧时长途跋涉就是一场苦役。

normal.en: tra-vel sounds like tuo-lei, dragging a tired body to a faraway place is exactly what a traveler does.
normal.cn: 「拖-累」谐音：拖着疲惫的身体去外地，正是旅行。

normal.en: travel light: light does double duty, few luggage and easy movement.
normal.cn: 搭配 travel light 里 light 一语双关：行李少，脚步轻。

normal.en: traveler = travel + -er, the person who does the traveling.
normal.cn: traveler 就是 travel 加 -er，做出旅行动作的人。

normal.en: news travels fast: even news travels, so the movement sense covers almost everything.
normal.cn: _news travels fast_ 连消息都会「跑」，可见 travel 的移动义几乎无处不在。

abstract.en: Picture your suitcase rolling away from your door on its own, drawing a long line across the map.
abstract.cn: 想象行李箱自己滚出家门，在地图上拖出一条长长的线——那就是 travel 的路径。

abstract.en: Feel the train window: trees slide backward, distance shrinks, you are the one moving.
abstract.cn: 感受车窗外的树向后滑去、距离被缩短——移动的就是你，这就是 travel 的核心。

abstract.en: A rumor whispers in one ear and leaves from another, hopping from city to city like a tiny traveler.
abstract.cn: 谣言在耳边低语又飞走，像一个小小的旅行者 hop 一城又一城——传播也是 travel。

examples.en: They plan to travel across Europe by train.
examples.cn: 他们计划乘火车横穿欧洲旅行。

examples.en: Her travels in Asia lasted almost two years.
examples.cn: 她在亚洲的游历持续了将近两年。

examples.en: Light travels faster than sound.
examples.cn: 光的传播速度比声音快。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拖-累-哦」——拖着累兮兮的身子出门，一路奔波，就是 travel（旅行）。

root: travel 与 travail 同出古法语 travailler（劳作、辛苦做工），后者来自一般认为的拉丁语 trepalium（一种刑具，形制存疑）。原义「苦役」引申为「艰难跋涉」，后分化为两个词：travail 保留辛劳义，travel 专指旅行。

sensesIntro.en: From the act of making a journey, travel spreads to goods and vehicles on routes, to news and disease that spread, and finally to the noun for journeys themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: travel 从「进行旅程」出发，扩展到货物与交通工具的运送，再到消息与疾病的传播，最后形成指旅程本身的名词义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: leaving familiar ground and covering the distance to somewhere else
core.cn: 核心意象：离开熟悉的地面，跨过通向远方的距离

branches.en: People travel when they make journeys to far places.
branches.cn: 人前往远方旅行，对应「出游」义。

branches.en: Goods, mail, pistons, and balls also travel along routes and distances.
branches.cn: 货物、邮件、活塞、球体沿路线与距离移动，对应「运送」与「行程」义。

branches.en: News, viruses, and light travel from one place to many.
branches.cn: 消息、病毒、光向各处扩散，对应「传播」义。

branches.en: Bullets and fast machines travel with great speed.
branches.cn: 子弹与高速机械飞驰，对应「快速行进」义。

branches.en: The whole activity and the counted journeys become the noun travel and travels.
branches.cn: 整个活动与多段旅程固化为名词 travel 与 travels。

intro.en: Travel itself is a plain root, but the family around it uses common noun, agent, and adjective endings.
intro.cn: travel 本身是一个朴素的词根，其词族借助常见的名词、施动者与形容词后缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ancestor trepalium has no productive Latin prefix or suffix family in English, so the Latin cognate list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁祖先词 trepalium 在英语中没有留下能产的前后缀同族词，故拉丁同源词列表为空。

items.example: I travel for work every month.
The airport was full of travelers.

items.meaning: the act of, or describing something

items.meaningCN: 旅行的；巡回的（英式双写 l）

items.example: the travail of building a nation

items.meaning: to toil, to make a hard journey
items.meaningCN: 劳苦；艰难跋涉（中古英语形式）
items.example: in old texts men travailed over land and sea
items.exampleCN: 古文献中人们跋山涉水、历尽艰辛

derivatives.zh: travel 加施动者后缀 -er，义为「旅行者」
travel 加 -ing 作形容词，义为「旅行的；巡回的」

definition_zh: 对待；看待；治疗；招待；请客
definition_en: to behave towards someone in a certain way, to give medical care, or to pay for food for someone
core_image: 大人弯下腰，蹲到孩子眼睛的高度才开口说话
scene: 诊所里，医生对照片子一条条讲清病情，又叮嘱护士怎样照看。The doctor treated the burn with a cool dressing.
sceneCN: 这里 treat 是「治疗」（第 2 个义项：对病人施以医疗照顾）；句意为医生用冷敷处理了烫伤。先蹲下来与病人齐眼说话的画面，正是「对待」的本义。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ment 构成名词，义为「治疗；对待」
同根名词，义为「论著」
同根名词，义为「条约」

senses.title: To behave towards someone
senses.definition: to behave in a particular way towards a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式对待人或物
senses.example: She treats her students as equals.
senses.exampleCN: 她把学生当平等的人看待。
senses.why: The Latin tractare means to handle, and how you handle people is how you treat them.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tractare 意为「处理、摆弄」，你怎么摆弄人，就是怎么对待人。

senses.title: To give medical care
senses.definition: to give medical care to a sick or injured person
senses.definitionCN: 对病人或伤者施以医疗
senses.example: The doctor treated him for a broken wrist.
senses.exampleCN: 医生给他治腕骨骨折。
senses.why: Medicine is a special kind of handling, so the same verb takes on the clinic.
senses.whyCN: 医疗是处理的一种特别方式，于是同一个动词走进了诊室。

senses.title: To deal with a substance
senses.definition: to apply a process to a material so that it changes
senses.definitionCN: 对材料施加某种工序使其改变
senses.example: The wood is treated against rot.
senses.exampleCN: 这木材经过防腐处理。
senses.why: Handling a material with a chemical is literally a handling, and the verb fits.
senses.whyCN: 用化学品去处理材料，字面上就是「摆弄」，动词正合适。

senses.title: To give food or fun at your cost
senses.definition: to buy food or entertainment for someone as a gift
senses.definitionCN: 花钱请别人吃东西或娱乐
senses.example: He treated us to lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 他请我们吃了午饭。
senses.why: Handling someone generously in a social setting becomes paying for them.
senses.whyCN: 在社交场合大方地「对付」某人，就变成了替他们付钱。

senses.title: A gift or pleasure given
senses.definition: something enjoyable given as a gift, or a special pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 作为礼物给人的享受，或特别的乐事
senses.example: The trip was a real treat.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行真是难得的乐事。
senses.why: The noun keeps the sense of something generously handled and then given.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了「被大方地打理好然后送给人」的含义。

senses.title: To discuss or write about
senses.definition: to deal with a subject in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 以口头或书面方式讨论一个主题
senses.example: The book treats the subject briefly.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书对这个问题论述简略。
senses.why: Tractare also meant to discuss, the sense that survives in treatise and treaty.
senses.whyCN: tractare 也有「讨论」义，这层意思留在 treatise 与 treaty 里。

intro.en: The verb comes from Old French traitier, from Latin tractare, to handle or discuss.
intro.cn: 这个动词来自古法语 traitier，源头是拉丁语 tractare（处理、讨论）。

items.en: Trahere means to draw or pull, and tractare is its frequentative, to keep handling.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉，tractare 是它的反复形式，意为反复摆弄。

items.en: Traitier means to deal with a person, to negotiate, or to discuss a matter.
items.cn: 古法语 traitier 意为与人打交道、谈判或讨论某事。

items.en: English takes the verb for behaving towards people and for handling subjects.
items.cn: 英语借入这个动词，用于待人与论述主题。

items.en: Medicine turns handling into healing, and hospitality turns it into paying.
items.cn: 医学把「处理」变成治疗，好客把「处理」变成付钱。

items.en: The noun treat, a pleasure, appears much later than the verb.
items.cn: 名词 treat（乐事）比动词晚得多才出现。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tract- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of dealing with people or illness.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tract- 词干，近义组汇集表示待人、治病的其他动词。

entries.definition: a formal agreement between states
the way someone is dealt with, or cured
a long written work on a subject
to ask someone earnestly
to make a sick person well again
to deal with a person or thing
to become or make healthy
to receive guests and pay for them

normalIntro.en: Treat, treaty, treatise and treatment all grow from one Latin verb of handling.
normalIntro.cn: treat、treaty、treatise、treatment 都出自同一个表示「处理」的拉丁动词。

normal.en: Tractare is to handle, so treat is to handle a person, a wound, or a subject.
normal.cn: tractare 是处理，所以 treat 是处理一个人、一处伤或一个题目。

normal.en: Treatment is the noun: how someone or something is handled.
normal.cn: treatment 是名词：某人或某物被怎样处理。

normal.en: A treaty is a handling written down between states.
normal.cn: treaty 是国家之间写下来的「处理」。

normal.en: My treat means I pay, the handling made generous.
normal.cn: my treat 是我付钱，把「处理」变成了大方。

normal.en: The past is treated, and the door of the clinic uses the same word.
normal.cn: 过去式是 treated，诊所门上用的也是这个词。

abstract.en: Picture an adult bending to a child’s height before speaking.
abstract.cn: 想象大人弯到孩子的高度再开口。

abstract.en: The same bend is made over a wound, and over a hard material.
abstract.cn: 同一个弯腰，对着伤口，也对着硬材料。

abstract.en: Then see a hand reaching for the bill at dinner.
abstract.cn: 再看见饭后一只手去拿账单。

examples.en: They treated the old man with great respect.
examples.cn: 他们非常敬重这位老人。

examples.en: The nurse treated the cut and sent him home.
examples.cn: 护士处理了伤口就送他回家了。

examples.en: Let me treat you to a coffee.
examples.cn: 让我请你喝杯咖啡。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹特」——特别热情地吹一气，好好招待客人。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉）的反复形式 tractare（处理、讨论），经古法语 traitier 进入英语；同族有 treaty、treatment、treatise

sensesIntro.en: All senses are ways of handling something: a person, a wound, a material, a subject, or a bill.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项都是「处理」：处理一个人、一处伤、一种材料、一个题目，或一笔账。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an adult bending down to a child’s eye level.
core.cn: 核心意象：大人蹲到与孩子齐眼的高度。

branches.en: The social sense, how one person handles another.
branches.cn: 人际义：一个人怎样对待另一个人。

branches.en: The technical senses: handling a body or a material.
branches.cn: 技术义：处理身体或处理材料。

branches.en: The generous senses: paying, and the pleasure paid for.
branches.cn: 慷慨义：付钱，以及花钱买来的乐事。

branches.en: The written sense, kept alive in treatise and treaty.
branches.cn: 书面义：活在 treatise 与 treaty 里。

branches.en: The material sense, where timber is the thing handled.
branches.cn: 材料义：被处理的是木料。

intro.en: The verb is a worn-down Latin verb of handling, and its family is large.
intro.cn: 这个动词是磨圆了的拉丁语「处理」动词，词族很大。

latinIntro.en: The tract- stem appears in treat, treaty, treatment, tract, contract, and extract.
latinIntro.cn: tract- 词干出现在 treat、treaty、treatment、tract、contract 与 extract 里。

items.example: The stem gives tract and contract.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干生出 tract 与 contract。

items.meaning: to handle a person or thing

items.example: The treaty was signed in May.

items.meaning: a written handling of a subject
items.example: She wrote a treatise on bees.
items.exampleCN: 她写了一部论蜜蜂的著作。

definition_zh: 树；树木；树状图
definition_en: a tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches, or a branching diagram
core_image: 一棵大树在空地上撑开满枝的绿，树影铺过整条路
scene: 村口的空地上站着一棵老树，枝叶向四面伸展。An old tree at the village gate shades the whole road.
sceneCN: 这里 tree 是「树；树木」（第 1 个义项：有木质树干和枝条的高大植物）；句意为村口一棵老树把整条路都遮在荫里。空地上撑开枝叶的那棵老树，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 tree 加 -less 构成，义为「没有树的；无树木的」
由 tree 与 lined 复合，义为「两旁有树的」
由 tree 与 top 复合，义为「树梢」

senses.title: The tall plant
senses.definition: a plant with a hard wooden stem that grows tall and lives for many years
senses.definitionCN: 有坚硬木质主干、长得高大且寿命多年的植物
senses.example: An old tree at the village gate shades the whole road.
senses.exampleCN: 村口一棵老树把整条路都遮在荫里。
senses.why: The word has stayed close to its old English shape for more than a thousand years, naming the same thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个词一千多年来与它古英语的形态几乎不变，指的一直是同一件事。

senses.title: The branching drawing
senses.definition: a diagram whose lines branch out like the limbs of a tree
senses.definitionCN: 线条像树枝一样分岔的图表
senses.example: She drew the family tree on the back of an envelope.
senses.exampleCN: 她在信封背面画出了家谱。
senses.why: Because a trunk divides into branches, any chart that divides in this way borrows the word.
senses.whyCN: 因为树干分叉成枝，任何按这种方式分岔的图表都借用了这个词。

senses.title: Planting a memory
senses.definition: a tree planted to mark a person, an event, or a promise for the future
senses.definitionCN: 为纪念某人、某事或对未来的承诺而种下的树
senses.example: They planted a tree at the gate when their daughter was born.
senses.exampleCN: 女儿出生时，他们在门口种了一棵树。
senses.why: A tree outlives the person who plants it, so it became a living record, and the word carries that hope.
senses.whyCN: 树比种它的人活得更久，于是它成了一份活着的记录，这个词也带上了这种期望。

intro.en: Tree is one of the oldest words in English, unchanged in meaning since the Germanic period.
intro.cn: tree 是英语中最古老的词之一，自日耳曼语时期起词义未曾改变。

items.en: The Germanic root trewam named wood, tree, and the material of timber.
items.cn: 日耳曼语词根 trewam 指树、木以及木材。

items.en: Old English treow meant both a tree and the idea of faithfulness, a pair still visible in true.
items.cn: 古英语 treow 既指树，也指忠信，这一双义仍留在 true 里。

items.en: Middle English tre kept the plant sense and dropped the abstract one.
items.cn: 中古英语 tre 保留了植物的意义，舍弃了抽象义。

items.en: The spelling tree settled in the modern period.
items.cn: tree 这个拼写在近代固定下来。

items.en: Compounds such as treetop and tree-lined later built a whole family around it.
items.cn: treetop 与 tree-lined 等复合词后来围绕它建起整个词族。

note.en: The first group collects woody plants, the second collects branching or related forms.
note.cn: 第一组是木本植物，第二组是带枝干意象的词与相关形式。

entries.definition: The highest part of a tree.
Having no trees.
Having trees along its sides.
A low woody plant with many stems.
A small woody plant, smaller than a tree.
Wood prepared for building.

normalIntro.en: Tree is short and long-lived, a word whose sound has barely moved in a thousand years.
normalIntro.cn: tree 短小而长久，这个词的读音一千年几乎没变。

normal.en: The ending ee is long, like the vowel in see.
normal.cn: 词尾 ee 读长音，像 see 里的元音。

normal.en: A family tree draws people as branches.
normal.cn: 家谱把人画成枝条。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: trees.
normal.cn: 复数只加 s：trees。

normal.en: Treetop and treeline both put the tree first.
normal.cn: treetop 与 treeline 都把 tree 放在前面。

normal.en: The old meaning of faithfulness survives in the word true.
normal.cn: 忠信的古义留在 true 这个词里。

abstract.en: A trunk going up and then becoming many things.
abstract.cn: 一根树干向上走，然后变成许多东西。

abstract.en: Shade moving slowly across a road.
abstract.cn: 荫影缓慢地爬过一条路。

abstract.en: Roots as thick below as branches above.
abstract.cn: 地下的根和上面的枝一样粗。

examples.en: Two children are climbing the tree by the wall.
examples.cn: 两个孩子正在爬墙边的树。

examples.en: The branches of the apple tree touched the roof.
examples.cn: 苹果树的枝条碰到了屋顶。

examples.en: He traced the family branches back four hundred years.
examples.cn: 他把这支家谱追到了四百年前。

dict_mnemonic.text: tree 读音像「吹」——风一吹，满树的叶子都在动。

root: 古英语 treow，来自日耳曼语词根 trewam（木、树），与 true 的「忠信」古义同源；同族词有 treetop、treeless、tree-lined。

sensesIntro.en: First the living plant, then any diagram whose parts branch the way a tree does.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是活着的植物，再是任何像树一样分岔的图表。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a broad old tree shading a road.
core.cn: 核心意象：遮住一条路的老树。

branches.en: The plant branch: root, trunk, and leaf.
branches.cn: 植物分支：根、干与叶。

branches.en: The chart branch: lines that divide like limbs.
branches.cn: 图表分支：像枝干一样分开的线。

branches.en: The shape branch: both share one silhouette.
branches.cn: 形状分支：两者共有一个轮廓。

branches.en: The shade branch: a living tree changes the street.
branches.cn: 荫影分支：活树改变了街道。

branches.en: The family branch: names placed on the limbs.
branches.cn: 家族分支：名字被放到枝条上。

intro.en: Tree is a free Germanic stem that joins freely with other words to make compounds.
intro.cn: tree 是日耳曼语系的自由词干，可以自由与其他词组合成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The tree word itself is Germanic, but Latin supplies the woodland words below.
latinIntro.cn: 树这个词本身来自日耳曼语，但下面的林地词汇出自拉丁语。

items.example: The stem stands on its own as a full noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干本身就是一个完整名词。

items.example: It forms treeless, without any trees.
It forms treetop, the crown of a tree.
It forms tree-lined, with trees along the street.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tree-lined，街道两旁有树。

items.example: Trees were planted along the river.

items.meaning: a shelter built in a tree
items.example: The children built a treehouse in summer.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们夏天搭了一座树屋。

items.meaning: the height above which trees cannot grow
items.example: Above the treeline only grass survives.
items.exampleCN: 林木线以上只有草能存活。

items.meaning: the upper branches of a tree

definition_zh: 诡计；把戏；窍门；戏弄；哄骗
definition_en: a clever act meant to deceive or amuse someone, or to deceive a person in that way
core_image: 一只手把硬币从这个人眼前晃过，却从那人耳后取出
scene: 街头围了一圈人，那个戴帽子的男人把手绢一晃，鸽子从袖口飞了出来。He knows a trick that makes a coin disappear.
sceneCN: 这里 trick 是「戏法、把戏」（第 2 个义项：逗人一乐的巧妙手法）；句意为他会一个让硬币消失的戏法。手一晃、东西换个地方出现，正是这个词的核心画面。

derivatives.zh: 名词加 -y 构成形容词，义为「棘手的；狡猾的」
名词加 -ery 构成，义为「欺骗行径」
名词加 -ster 构成，义为「骗子；恶作剧者」

senses.title: A plan to deceive someone
senses.definition: a clever but dishonest plan to get something from someone
senses.definitionCN: 巧妙却不老实、想从别人那里得利的计谋
senses.example: It was a trick to make him sign the paper.
senses.exampleCN: 那是个骗他签字的诡计。
senses.why: The word comes from Old French trickier, to deceive, and its oldest sense is a cheat or a deceit.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自古法语 trickier（欺骗），最早的义项就是骗人或骗术。

senses.title: A clever act that amuses
senses.definition: a skilful performance, such as a card trick, done to entertain
senses.definitionCN: 为逗乐而做的熟练表演，如纸牌戏法
senses.example: The children loved the card trick.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们很喜欢那个纸牌戏法。
senses.why: A cheat and a magic show differ only in intent: both turn on a hidden method.
senses.whyCN: 骗人的手法与魔术表演只差用心：两者都靠一套藏着的方法。

senses.title: A clever way of doing something
senses.definition: a special way of doing a task that makes it easier
senses.definitionCN: 让事情变容易的特殊做法
senses.example: The trick is to stir the sauce slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 窍门是慢慢地搅酱汁。
senses.why: The hidden method that deceived someone can also simply help: then we call it the trick.
senses.whyCN: 那套藏着的方法如果不为骗人而是帮忙，我们就叫它窍门。

senses.title: To deceive someone
senses.definition: to make someone believe something untrue so that you gain an advantage
senses.definitionCN: 让人相信不实之事以取得好处
senses.example: They tricked him out of his savings.
senses.exampleCN: 他们骗走了他的存款。
senses.why: The verb is the act behind the noun: to work the hidden method on a person.
senses.whyCN: 动词是名词背后的动作：把藏着的方法用在某个人身上。

senses.title: A habit or mannerism
senses.definition: a peculiar habit of speech or behaviour that a person is known for
senses.definitionCN: 某人为人熟知的言语或举止习惯
senses.example: He has a trick of raising one eyebrow.
senses.exampleCN: 他有个挑一挑眉的习惯。
senses.why: A repeated piece of behaviour becomes as automatic as a practised sleight.
senses.whyCN: 反复出现的小动作，会像练熟的手法一样成为本能。

intro.en: The word comes from Old French trique, a deceit or a cheat, and the verb trickier, to deceive.
intro.cn: 这个词来自古法语 trique（欺骗、诈术）与动词 trickier（欺骗）。

items.en: Trique means a deceit, a shift, or a cheating play, and is used of dice and dealings.
items.cn: 古法语 trique 意为诈术、花招、骗人的把戏，用于骰子与交易。

items.en: English borrows the noun in the fifteenth century for a deceitful act.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入这个名词，指欺诈行为。

items.en: By the sixteenth century the word covers harmless sleight of hand and card play.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，这个词已涵盖无害的手法与纸牌戏法。

items.en: Later it names the clever knack of a trade and the odd habit of a person.
items.cn: 后来又用来指行业的技巧与一个人的怪癖。

items.en: The ultimate origin is uncertain; the word may be related to Old French trichier, to cheat.
items.cn: 最终来源不确定；可能和古法语 trichier（欺骗）有关。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words differing by one letter or sharing the stem, while the near-meaning group names other deceptions and knacks.
note.cn: 形近组汇集只差一个字母或共用词干的短词，近义组列出其他骗术与诀窍。

entries.definition: difficult or requiring care
the use of tricks to deceive
a large road vehicle
to flow in a thin slow stream
a playful trick on someone
to make someone believe what is false
a special skill at doing something
a false appearance made by a performer

normalIntro.en: Five letters, one sharp sound, and a family that grows from it.
normalIntro.cn: 五个字母，一个短促的音，还长出一整个词族。

normal.en: Tricky adds -y and means full of tricks, so difficult.
normal.cn: tricky 加 -y，意为满是机关，所以是棘手。

normal.en: Trickery adds -ery and names the practice of deceiving.
normal.cn: trickery 加 -ery，指欺骗的行径。

normal.en: A trickster is the person who plays the tricks.
normal.cn: trickster 就是耍弄这些把戏的人。

normal.en: Do the trick means the method works, with no deceit at all.
normal.cn: do the trick 指办法奏效，毫无欺骗之意。

normal.en: The verb takes a direct object and usually into: trick him into signing.
normal.cn: 这个动词带宾语，常加 into：trick him into signing。

abstract.en: Picture a coin leaving one palm and appearing behind an ear.
abstract.cn: 想象硬币离开一只手心，却出现在耳后。

abstract.en: Watch the empty palm open flat to prove nothing is there.
abstract.cn: 看那只空手摊平，证明什么也没有。

abstract.en: Then put that same sleight into a recipe and call it the trick.
abstract.cn: 再把这套手法放进菜谱里，就叫做窍门。

examples.en: The old trick of hiding a key under a flowerpot failed.
examples.cn: 把钥匙藏在花盆下这个老花招不管用了。

examples.en: It took me a while to learn the trick of folding the dough.
examples.cn: 我花了好一阵才学会折面团的窍门。

examples.en: They tricked the old man into paying twice.
examples.cn: 他们骗那位老人付了两次钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹克」——一脚踹开攻克对手的诡计，全靠手法。

root: 古法语 trique（诈术）与动词 trickier（欺骗），十五世纪进入英语；同族有 tricky、trickery、trickster，最终来源不确定

sensesIntro.en: One hidden method runs through every sense: it may cheat, amuse, help, or simply become a habit.
sensesIntro.cn: 一套藏着的方法贯穿所有义项：它可以骗人、逗乐、帮忙，或干脆变成一个习惯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coin that leaves one palm and appears elsewhere.
core.cn: 核心意象：硬币离开一只手心，在别处出现。

branches.en: The deceitful sense, where the method is used against someone.
branches.cn: 欺骗义：那套方法被用来对付人。

branches.en: The performing sense, where the method only entertains.
branches.cn: 表演义：那套方法只为逗乐。

branches.en: The helpful sense, where the same method makes work easy.
branches.cn: 助人义：同一套方法让活变简单。

branches.en: The verb sense, where the method is set in motion.
branches.cn: 动词义：把那套方法使出来。

branches.en: The habitual sense, where a mannerism repeats like a practised move.
branches.cn: 习惯义：小动作像练熟的手法一样重复。

intro.en: The word is short, but it builds a family with three productive suffixes.
intro.cn: 这个词很短，却靠三个能产的词尾长出一族词。

latinIntro.en: The French source has no Latin relatives in English, so the Latin list here stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 它的法语来源在英语里没有拉丁亲族，所以这里的拉丁同源词留空。

items.example: He played a trick on us.

items.exampleCN: 一道棘手的题难住了所有人。

items.example: The trickster fooled the whole village.

items.exampleCN: 这条小路刁钻地往山下走。

items.example: He underestimated the trickiness of the task.
items.exampleCN: 他低估了这件事的棘手程度。

items.meaning: a question designed to catch you

items.example: The children shouted trick or treat.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们喊着不给糖就捣蛋。

items.example: The move looked tricky, even trickish.
items.exampleCN: 这一步看着就刁，甚至有点诡。

definition_zh: 旅行；旅程；绊倒；（药物引起的）迷幻体验
definition_en: a journey to a place and back, especially a short one, or an act of catching your foot and stumbling
core_image: 一列小火车似的巴士沿山路开进雾里，车窗上映着笑脸
scene: 周末清晨，一群人背着包上了开往山里的巴士。We took a trip to the mountains and stayed for two nights.
sceneCN: 这里 trip 是「旅行；旅程」（第 1 个义项：去某地再回来的行程，尤指短途）；句意为我们去山里旅行，住了两晚。清晨背包装车的那群人，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 trip 加 -er 构成，义为「（短途）游客」
由 trip 加 -ing 构成，义为「轻快的（步伐）」
以 tri-（三）构成，义为「三脚架」

senses.title: Out and back
senses.definition: a journey to a place, especially a short one that ends at home
senses.definitionCN: 到某地的一次行程，尤指以回家告终的短途
senses.example: We took a trip to the mountains and stayed for two nights.
senses.exampleCN: 我们去山里旅行了一趟，住了两晚。
senses.why: The word may come from an old verb for skipping, because a short journey is a lively hop out and back.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可能源自意为「轻跳」的旧动词，因为短途出行就是轻快地跳出再回来。

senses.title: The foot catches
senses.definition: to catch your foot on something and lose balance
senses.definitionCN: 脚被某物挡住而失去平衡
senses.example: He tripped over the edge of the carpet.
senses.exampleCN: 他被地毯的边角绊了一下。
senses.why: A hop that goes wrong becomes a stumble, and this literal sense still lives in the verb.
senses.whyCN: 跳得不好就成了踉跄，这一字面含义仍留在动词里。

senses.title: Setting something off
senses.definition: to cause a switch or a machine to start working
senses.definitionCN: 使开关或机器开始运作
senses.example: A loose wire tripped the alarm at midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 一根松动的电线在半夜触发了警报。
senses.why: A light foot catches a lever, and the mechanism starts, so machines also get tripped.
senses.whyCN: 轻脚一碰钩住杠杆，机构便启动，于是机器也会被 trip。

senses.title: A single outbound turn
senses.definition: one leg of a journey, counted as a single unit
senses.definitionCN: 行程中的一段，按一个单位计数
senses.example: The truck made four trips between the quarry and the site.
senses.exampleCN: 卡车在采石场和工地之间跑了四趟。
senses.why: When journeys are counted, each single run out and back becomes one trip by itself.
senses.whyCN: 当行程被计数时，每一趟出去再回来本身就成了一次 trip。

intro.en: Trip is a short English word of uncertain origin, probably connected with old verbs for skipping and stumbling.
intro.cn: trip 是来源不确定的短小英语词，可能与表示跳跃与踉跄的旧动词有关。

items.en: No sure source is known; it appears in the Middle English period as a verb of light movement.
items.cn: 确切来源不明；它在中古英语时期已作为表示轻快动作的动词出现。

items.en: To trippen meant to step lightly, and also to stumble on a stone.
items.cn: trippen 意为轻步走，也指在石头上踉跄。

items.en: A short sea voyage was called a trip in the early modern period.
items.cn: 近代早期，一段短途海上航程被称作 a trip。

items.en: By the nineteenth century a trip covered any short journey by train or coach.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，trip 已指任何乘火车或马车的短途行程。

items.en: The machine sense, tripping a switch, grew out of the same light touch.
items.cn: 触发开关的机械义同样出自那次轻碰。

note.en: The first group shares the trip stem and sound, the second holds words for journeys and stumbles.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trip 的词干与读音，第二组收表示旅程与踉跄的词。

entries.definition: A person on a short trip.
Moving lightly or catching the foot.
Stumbled or set off a device.
Travel from one place to another.
A short pleasure trip with others.
To catch the foot and nearly fall.

normalIntro.en: Trip is a tiny word with two lives: a small hop out somewhere, and a small hop that goes wrong.
normalIntro.cn: trip 这个词很小，却有两重生活：轻快地跳出去一趟，以及轻跳失手的一下。

normal.en: Take a trip means go out and come back.
normal.cn: take a trip 意为出去再回来。

normal.en: Past forms double the p: tripped, tripping.
normal.cn: 过去式双写 p：tripped、tripping。

normal.en: Trip over is the everyday stumble phrase.
normal.cn: trip over 是日常的绊倒说法。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: trips.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：trips。

normal.en: Tripper turns the word into a person.
normal.cn: tripper 把这个词变成一个人。

abstract.en: A duffel bag by the door on a Friday night.
abstract.cn: 周五晚上门口的一只行李包。

abstract.en: A stone on a path you did not look at.
abstract.cn: 路上你没留意的一块石头。

abstract.en: A light foot catching a wire and waking the alarm.
abstract.cn: 轻脚绊到一根线，把警报唤醒。

examples.en: The bus leaves before dawn for a day trip to the lake.
examples.cn: 去湖边一日游的大巴在天亮前出发。

examples.en: She tripped on the last stair and dropped her keys.
examples.cn: 她在最后一级台阶绊了一下，钥匙掉在地上。

examples.en: Our trip to the coast was cut short by the storm.
examples.cn: 我们的海边之行被暴风雨提前中断。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹蒲」——吹着蒲公英去旅行；脚下一绊，就是 trip 的另一义。

root: 来源不确定（中古英语 trippen 意为轻步走、踉跄），近代扩展出「短途旅行」与「触发装置」两义；同族词有 tripper、tripping、tripped。

sensesIntro.en: First the short journey, then the stumble, then the small touch that sets a device going.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是短途旅行，再是踉跄，最后是那点轻碰把装置启动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bag by the door and a stone on the path.
core.cn: 核心意象：门口的行囊与路上的一块石头。

branches.en: The journey branch: a short way out and back.
branches.cn: 旅程分支：短程出去再回来。

branches.en: The body branch: a foot catching and slipping.
branches.cn: 身体分支：脚绊住并滑开。

branches.en: The mechanism branch: a light touch starts a machine.
branches.cn: 机械分支：轻轻一碰让机器启动。

branches.en: The hop branch: both grew from a light skip.
branches.cn: 跳跃分支：两者都出自轻跳。

branches.en: The trigger branch: feet and levers both catch.
branches.cn: 触发分支：脚与杠杆都会被钩住。

intro.en: Trip is a free stem of uncertain origin that easily takes endings such as -er and -ing.
intro.cn: trip 是来源不明的自由词干，可以方便地加上 -er、-ing 等词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the journey words below, which are cousins rather than direct ancestors.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的旅程词汇出自拉丁语，它们只是远亲而非直接祖先。

items.example: The stem also works as a verb.
It forms tripper, a short-trip visitor.

items.exampleCN: 它构成 tripping，轻快行进的。

items.example: Two trips in one month were too many.
items.exampleCN: 一个月两次旅行太多了。

items.example: The p doubles before the ending.
items.exampleCN: 加词尾前 p 要双写。

items.example: Day fixes the length of the outing.
items.exampleCN: day 限定了出游的长度。

items.example: Business names the reason for the journey.
The same letters open a word about three feet.
items.exampleCN: 同样的字母开头，构成了关于三只脚的词。

definition_zh: 麻烦；困难；烦扰；使烦恼；疾病
definition_en: a problem or difficulty, or the act of making someone worried or upset
core_image: 水面被搅得浑起来，鱼看不见，连倒影都碎了
scene: 深夜，修车师傅蹲在路边，车前盖敞开着，车主来回踱步打电话。The old car has given us a lot of trouble this year.
sceneCN: 这里 trouble 是「麻烦」（第 1 个义项：让人头疼的问题）；句意为这辆旧车今年给我们添了不少麻烦。搅浑的水面与来回踱步的画面正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 名词加 -some 构成形容词，义为「麻烦的；讨厌的」
过去分词形容词化，义为「困扰的；动荡的」
合成词，义为「惹麻烦的人」

senses.title: A problem or difficulty
senses.definition: a problem, difficulty, or unpleasant situation that must be dealt with
senses.definitionCN: 需要处理的难题、困难或令人不快的处境
senses.example: We had trouble finding the address.
senses.exampleCN: 我们找这个地址费了点劲。
senses.why: The verb behind the word means to stir up or disturb, and a stirred situation becomes a problem.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后的动词意为搅动、扰乱，被搅乱的情形就成了麻烦。

senses.title: Worry or distress
senses.definition: a feeling of worry, anxiety, or unhappiness
senses.definitionCN: 担忧、焦虑或不快的情绪
senses.example: Her troubles seemed to lift after the call.
senses.exampleCN: 那通电话之后她的烦恼似乎散了。
senses.why: The stir that clouds the water also clouds the mind, so the word names inner unrest.
senses.whyCN: 搅浑水面的动荡同样会搅浑心里，所以这个词也指内心的不安。

senses.title: To cause someone worry
senses.definition: to make someone worried, annoyed, or uncomfortable
senses.definitionCN: 使某人担忧、不快或不安
senses.example: The noise troubled her all night.
senses.exampleCN: 那噪声扰了她一整夜。
senses.why: To trouble is to stir someone up, exactly as a stick stirs a pond.
senses.whyCN: trouble 就是把人搅动起来，正如一根棍子搅动池塘。

senses.title: Illness or a fault in a machine
senses.definition: an illness, or a fault in a machine or a part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 疾病，或机器、身体某部位出的毛病
senses.example: He has heart trouble and walks slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 他有心脏病，走路很慢。
senses.why: A body or an engine that is not running smoothly is in a disturbed state, so it has a trouble.
senses.whyCN: 身体或发动机运转不顺就是处于被扰动的状态，于是有了毛病。

senses.title: Extra effort taken to help
senses.definition: extra effort that one takes in order to do something for others
senses.definitionCN: 为他人做事而额外花的力气
senses.example: She took the trouble to write by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 她不嫌麻烦地手写了信。
senses.why: Stirring up effort on someone’s behalf is also a trouble, and the phrase keeps that effort visible.
senses.whyCN: 为别人搅起一番力气也是一种 trouble，这个短语把那份力气显出来。

intro.en: The word goes back through Old French to late Latin turbulare, to stir up, from turbare, to disturb.
intro.cn: 这个词经古法语回溯到晚期拉丁语 turbulare（搅动），源于 turbare（扰乱）。

items.en: Turba means a crowd, a tumult, or a disturbance, and turbare means to throw into confusion.
items.cn: 拉丁语 turba 意为人群、骚动、扰乱，动词 turbare 意为使混乱。

items.en: Turbulare, to stir up, is formed on turba and gives the later Romance words.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 turbulare（搅动）由 turba 构成，生出后来的罗曼语词。

items.en: Old French troubler means to disturb and also to make a liquid cloudy.
items.cn: 古法语 troubler 意为扰乱，也指把液体搅浑。

items.en: English borrows the noun and verb in the thirteenth century with both the literal and the mental sense.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入名词与动词，字面义与心理义一并带入。

items.en: Engineering and medicine give it the concrete senses of a fault and an illness.
items.cn: 工程与医学给了它「故障」与「疾病」两个具体义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Latin turb- family, while the near-meaning group names other problems and worries.
note.cn: 形近组汇集同出拉丁语 turb- 词族的词，近义组列出其他问题与烦恼的说法。

entries.definition: causing difficulty or annoyance
worried or full of conflict
full of sudden violent movement
to interrupt or upset someone
a matter that is hard to solve
the state of being hard to do
a state of anxious thought
a person or thing that annoys

normalIntro.en: The b turns to bl before the ending, and the word keeps the picture of stirred water.
normalIntro.cn: 词尾前 b 变成 bl，这个词始终带着搅水的画面。

normal.en: Troublesome adds -some and means full of trouble.
normal.cn: troublesome 加 -some，意为满是麻烦。

normal.en: Have trouble doing takes the -ing form after it.
normal.cn: have trouble doing 后面接动名词。

normal.en: Troubled is the adjective for a worried face or a troubled time.
normal.cn: troubled 形容人的忧色或动荡的时期。

normal.en: Turbulent and disturb share the same Latin root.
normal.cn: turbulent 与 disturb 共用同一个拉丁词根。

normal.en: The verb takes a direct object: the news troubled him.
normal.cn: 这个动词带宾语：那消息让他不安。

abstract.en: Picture a stick stirring a clear pond into brown.
abstract.cn: 想象一根棍子把清澈的池塘搅成褐色。

abstract.en: Watch the reflection break into pieces.
abstract.cn: 看倒影碎成一片片。

abstract.en: Wait until it settles, and the water is clear again.
abstract.cn: 等它静下来，水又清了。

examples.en: She had great trouble getting the machine to start.
examples.cn: 她费了好大劲才把机器发动起来。

examples.en: His back trouble keeps him from lifting boxes.
examples.cn: 他的背疾让他不能搬箱子。

examples.en: The question troubled her for days.
examples.cn: 那个问题困扰了她好几天。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿不了」——鞋挤得穿不了，真是麻烦。

root: 拉丁语 turba（骚动）+ turbare（扰乱）→ 晚期拉丁语 turbulare → 古法语 troubler；同族有 turbulent、disturb

sensesIntro.en: The senses all come from a stirred thing: water, a mind, a body, or a machine.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项都来自被搅动的东西：水、心、身体，或机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stick stirring a clear pond until it is brown.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根棍子把清水搅成褐色。

branches.en: The plain problem sense, where affairs are stirred.
branches.cn: 麻烦义：被搅的是事情。

branches.en: The mind pair: worry felt and worry caused.
branches.cn: 心理一对：心里的烦与被搅起的烦。

branches.en: The concrete sense, where a body or a machine is disturbed.
branches.cn: 具体义：被扰动的是身体或机器。

branches.en: The effort sense, where stirring up work is meant.
branches.cn: 用力义：搅起的是一番力气。

branches.en: The problem sense again, where the water will not settle.
branches.cn: 再回麻烦义：水一时沉不下去。

latinIntro.en: Turba and turbare lie behind trouble, turbulent, and disturb.
latinIntro.cn: turba 与 turbare 支撑着 trouble、turbulent 与 disturb。

definition_zh: 卡车；货车；手推车；用卡车运送
definition_en: a large road vehicle with a strong body for carrying goods, or a small cart pushed by hand
core_image: 一辆满载木箱的大卡车轰隆隆地驶过仓库门口
scene: 仓库门口的坡道上，一辆大车正缓缓倒进来，后厢门放平搭在地上。A truck loaded with boxes pulled into the yard before six.
sceneCN: 这里 truck 是「卡车；货车」（第 1 个义项：在公路上运货的大型车辆）；句意为一辆装满箱子的卡车六点前开进院子。坡道上缓缓倒车的那个大家伙，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 truck 加 -er 构成，义为「卡车司机」
由 truck 与 load 复合，义为「一卡车的量」
由 truck 加 -ing 构成，义为「卡车运输业」

senses.title: The big goods carrier
senses.definition: a large motor vehicle built to carry heavy loads along roads
senses.definitionCN: 在公路上运送重货的大型机动车
senses.example: A truck loaded with boxes pulled into the yard before six.
senses.exampleCN: 一辆装满箱子的卡车六点前开进院子。
senses.why: The word began as a small wheel and grew into the machine that rides on those wheels.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指一只小轮子，后来长成了靠那些轮子行走的机器。

senses.title: The small hand cart
senses.definition: a low open cart with wheels, pushed by hand or pulled by a person
senses.definitionCN: 带轮的低矮敞篷小车，用手推或拉
senses.example: He wheeled a truck of bricks across the yard.
senses.exampleCN: 他用一辆手推车把砖推过院子。
senses.why: Older English used truck for a small wheel, so the little cart named itself after its wheels.
senses.whyCN: 早期英语用 truck 指小轮子，于是那辆小车是以它的轮子命名的。

senses.title: To move by truck
senses.definition: to carry goods in a truck from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 用卡车把货物从一处运到另一处
senses.example: The company trucks fresh vegetables to the city each night.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司每晚把新鲜蔬菜用卡车运到城里。
senses.why: Once the vehicle had a name, the verb simply followed: to truck goods is to move them by truck.
senses.whyCN: 车辆有了名字，动词就顺势而生：truck goods 就是用卡车运货。

intro.en: Truck probably comes through French from the Latin trochus, a wheel or hoop, and its first English sense was a small wheel.
intro.cn: truck 大概经法语来自拉丁语 trochus（轮、圈），它在英语里的第一个含义是「小轮子」。

items.en: Trokhos meant a wheel or a circular course.
items.cn: trokhos 意为轮子或环行的路径。

items.en: Trochus named an iron hoop used in games and, later, any wheel.
items.cn: trochus 指游戏用的铁圈，后来泛指轮子。

items.en: Troque named a pulley wheel or a small wooden wheel.
items.cn: troque 指滑轮或小木轮。

items.en: English truck first meant a small wheel, then the low cart that ran on them.
items.cn: 英语 truck 先指小轮，再指靠这些小轮行走的低矮车。

items.en: With engines the cart grew into the heavy road vehicle of today.
items.cn: 有了发动机，那辆车长成了今天公路上的重型车辆。

note.en: The first group shares the truck stem, the second holds other words for goods vehicles.
note.cn: 第一组共享 truck 词干，第二组收其他表示载货车与运货的词。

entries.definition: A person who drives a truck.
As much as a truck can carry.
The business of moving goods by road.
The British word for a large goods vehicle.
A smaller covered vehicle for light loads.
A small vehicle with wheels, often pulled.

normalIntro.en: Truck is a short, blunt word that sounds like the noise of a heavy vehicle on a rough road.
normalIntro.cn: truck 短促粗硬，听起来就像重型车在颠簸路上的声音。

normal.en: The past forms add a k sound: trucked, trucking.
normal.cn: 过去式加 k 音：trucked、trucking。

normal.en: Trucker is the driver, trucking is the business.
normal.cn: trucker 是司机，trucking 是运输业。

normal.en: A truckload says how much the vehicle can hold.
normal.cn: truckload 说明这辆车能装多少。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: trucks.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：trucks。

normal.en: The first English meaning was simply a small wheel.
normal.cn: 英语里最早的含义只是「小轮子」。

abstract.en: A back door lowering to the ground like a drawbridge.
abstract.cn: 后门像吊桥一样放下来。

abstract.en: Dust rising behind a heavy load on a dirt road.
abstract.cn: 土路上重车后扬起的尘土。

abstract.en: A single wheel rolling on its own before any cart exists.
abstract.cn: 在有车之前，一只轮子独自滚动。

examples.en: The truck stopped by the river to unload the sand.
examples.cn: 卡车在河边停下卸沙。

examples.en: Farmers truck their milk to the factory before sunrise.
examples.cn: 农民在日出前用卡车把牛奶运到工厂。

examples.en: A truck of hay stood by the barn door.
examples.cn: 一辆装满干草的手推车停在谷仓门口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳克」——大车一开过来，路面被戳得咔咔响，就是卡车。

root: 可能经法语 troque 来自拉丁语 trochus（铁圈、轮子），再上溯希腊语 trokhos；本义「小轮子」，后指手推车、载货卡车；同族词有 trucker、truckload、trucking。

sensesIntro.en: First the heavy road vehicle, then the little hand cart, then the verb of carrying by truck.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是重型公路车辆，再是小手推车，最后是用卡车运送的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a back door lowering onto a loading ramp.
core.cn: 核心意象：后门放下搭到装卸坡上。

branches.en: The vehicle branch: the engine replaced the horse.
branches.cn: 车辆分支：发动机取代了马。

branches.en: The cart branch: the small wheel still survives.
branches.cn: 小车分支：小轮子的影子仍在。

branches.en: The action branch: moving goods by road.
branches.cn: 动作分支：沿公路运送货物。

branches.en: The road branch: the truck and its work share one picture.
branches.cn: 公路分支：车与它的活儿共用一幅画。

branches.en: The wheel branch: both still run on wheels.
branches.cn: 轮子分支：两者都靠轮子行走。

intro.en: Truck is a short free stem that takes -er, -ing and compound forms easily.
intro.cn: truck 是短小的自由词干，容易接 -er、-ing 以及复合形式。

latinIntro.en: The Greek and Latin source trochus, a wheel, also gives the technical words below.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语与拉丁语来源 trochus（轮子）还生出下面的技术词。

items.example: The stem works as noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干可作名词与动词。

items.example: It forms trucking, the road freight trade.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trucking，公路货运业。

items.meaning: as much as can be carried
items.example: It forms truckload, one full load.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 truckload，一整车的量。

items.example: The stone was trucked from the quarry.
items.exampleCN: 石头是从采石场用卡车运来的。

items.example: They are trucking the harvest south.
items.exampleCN: 他们正把收成运往南方。

items.example: Fire names the job of the vehicle.
items.exampleCN: fire 说明这辆车的工作。

definition_zh: 信任；信赖；相信；信托
definition_en: to believe that someone is honest and will not harm you, or a firm belief in a person or thing
core_image: 一个人把钥匙交到另一个人手里，手心稳稳托着
scene: 门口站着一位老人，把一串钥匙放进年轻邻居的掌心。She trusted her neighbour with the keys to the house.
sceneCN: 这里 trust 是「信任；信赖」（第 1 个义项：相信某人诚实、不会伤害你）；句意为她把房子的钥匙交给邻居保管，信任他。钥匙放进手心的那一刻，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 trust 与 worthy 复合，义为「值得信任的」
由 trust 加 -ful 构成，义为「轻信的；信任的」
由 dis-（否定）与 trust 复合，义为「不信任」

senses.title: Believing in a person
senses.definition: to believe that someone is honest and reliable
senses.definitionCN: 相信某人诚实可靠
senses.example: She trusted her neighbour with the keys to the house.
senses.exampleCN: 她把房子的钥匙交给邻居保管，信任他。
senses.why: The old word meant firmness and comfort, and to trust someone is to rest firmly on them.
senses.whyCN: 这个古词意为牢固与安心，而信任某人就是稳稳地靠在他身上。

senses.title: The firm belief itself
senses.definition: the feeling that you can depend on someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 觉得可以依靠某人或某物的感觉
senses.example: Years of work had built trust between the two teams.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的合作在两个团队之间建立了信任。
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun, naming the steady feeling that makes trusting possible.
senses.whyCN: 动词变成名词，命名那种让信任得以发生的稳固感觉。

senses.title: Money held for others
senses.definition: a legal arrangement in which one person holds property for another
senses.definitionCN: 由一人替另一人持有财产的法律安排
senses.example: The money was left in trust for the children.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔钱被委托保管，留给孩子们。
senses.why: If you trust someone, you may hand them your property to hold, and law gave that act a formal name.
senses.whyCN: 若你信任某人，你可能会把财产交给他保管，法律给这个行为起了正式的名字。

intro.en: Trust comes from the Old Norse traust, a word for help and firm support, and it is cousin to true.
intro.cn: trust 来自古诺斯语 traust，意为帮助与坚固的支撑，与 true 同源。

items.en: The root treuwaz meant firm and loyal, shared with true and truth.
items.cn: 词根 treuwaz 意为牢固、忠实，与 true、truth 共享。

items.en: Traust named confident hope and the help that made a person feel safe.
items.cn: traust 指有把握的期望，以及使人感到安全的那种帮助。

items.en: English took trust for the feeling that someone will not fail you.
items.cn: 英语借入 trust 表示「某人不会让你失望」的感觉。

items.en: Law developed the trust, a formal arrangement for holding property.
items.cn: 法律发展出 trust，即持有财产的正式安排。

items.en: Business names such as trust bank grew from that legal use.
items.cn: trust bank 之类的商业名称都出自这一法律用法。

note.en: The first group shares the trust stem, the second holds other words about belief and confidence.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trust 词干，第二组收其他表示相信与自信的词。

entries.definition: Deserving to be trusted.
Relied on over a long time.
A lack of trust.
To accept that something is true.
To depend on someone or something.
A firm feeling of certainty.

normalIntro.en: Trust begins like true and ends with a firm -st, the shape of a word that stands still.
normalIntro.cn: trust 以 true 的样子开头，结尾是坚硬的 -st，像个站着不动的词。

normal.en: The ending -st appears in firm words such as steadfast.
normal.cn: 结尾 -st 出现在 steadfast 这类表示稳固的词语里。

normal.en: The past form simply adds ed: trusted.
normal.cn: 过去式直接加 ed：trusted。

normal.en: Trust someone with something means put it in their hands.
normal.cn: trust someone with something 意为把它交到他手上。

normal.en: Distrust adds dis, the prefix of undoing.
normal.cn: distrust 加 dis，这是表示否定的前缀。

normal.en: A trust in law is money held for another person.
normal.cn: 法律上的 trust 是为他人保管的钱。

abstract.en: A bunch of keys placed in an open palm.
abstract.cn: 一串钥匙被放进摊开的手掌。

abstract.en: A rope tied off and held without looking.
abstract.cn: 一根系紧后不用看就握住的绳。

abstract.en: The quiet after someone says I will be there.
abstract.cn: 有人说「我会在」之后的那份安静。

examples.en: I trust her to keep the plan secret.
examples.cn: 我相信她会保守这个计划。

examples.en: Trust between the two sides took years to build.
examples.cn: 双方的信任用了几年才建立起来。

examples.en: The fund was set up in trust for the children.
examples.cn: 这笔基金以信托方式为孩子们设立。

dict_mnemonic.text: trust 与 true 同源——把心稳稳托住对方的真实，就是信任。

root: 古诺斯语 traust（帮助、坚固的支持），来自日耳曼语词根 treuwaz（牢固、忠实），与 true、truth 同源；同族词有 trustworthy、trustful、distrust。

sensesIntro.en: First the act of believing in someone, then the steady feeling itself, then the legal arrangement that feeling allows.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是相信某人的动作，再是那种稳固的感觉，最后是这种感觉所允许的法律安排。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: keys placed in an open palm.
core.cn: 核心意象：钥匙放进摊开的手掌。

branches.en: The person branch: believing someone will not fail.
branches.cn: 人分支：相信某人不会失信。

branches.en: The feeling branch: confidence that stays.
branches.cn: 感受分支：持续存在的信心。

branches.en: The property branch: valuables handed to another.
branches.cn: 财产分支：贵重物交到他人手里。

branches.en: The bond branch: action and feeling feed each other.
branches.cn: 纽带分支：行动与感受互相滋养。

branches.en: The paper branch: a feeling written into law.
branches.cn: 文书分支：把感情写成法律。

intro.en: Trust is a Norse free stem that English combines with worthy, -ful and the prefix dis-.
intro.cn: trust 是诺斯语来源的自由词干，英语把它与 worthy、-ful 以及前缀 dis- 组合。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Norse rather than Latin; the Latin words below express the same idea from another family.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干来自诺斯语而非拉丁语；下面的拉丁词出自另一词族但表达同一概念。

items.exampleCN: 这个词干可作动词与名词。
它构成 trustworthy，值得信任的。

items.example: It forms trustful, full of trust.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trustful，充满信任的。

items.example: It forms trusting, ready to trust.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 trusting，愿意信任的。

items.example: It forms distrust, the lack of trust.
En makes the noun into an action of handing over.
items.exampleCN: en 把名词变成交付的动作。

items.example: The ending makes a description of the past.
items.exampleCN: 词尾构成对过去状态的描述。

items.meaning: one who holds property for another
